description.p: VaultBoard is a modern Kanban board utility for the desktop, inspired by Trello but built around one rule: your tasks never leave your machine. Boards, lists and cards are stored locally and persist across restarts, with no account, no cloud and no network access.

ul.li: Multiple boards with a collapsible sidebar
Unlimited lists per board, drag-and-drop cards and lists
Priority labels, descriptions and completion tracking
Instant local search across the whole board
